input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal terms meet our preferred position in full: automatic renewals are limited to successive twelve-month periods (§ 8.2), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (within the 30-day maximum), Vendor must send a renewal reminder at least sixty days before renewal (with Customer's opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed, which is additional protection for us), and renewal uplifts are capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent (§ 8.3), plus ninety days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods. No multi-year automatic renewal or long non-renewal window appears anywhere in the document, so no redline is required.
